newsitem.title: CHINA: China EB Holdings buys 166 mln Angang H-shares.
newsitem.headline: China EB Holdings buys 166 mln Angang H-shares.

text.p: China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd said on Wednesday it has acquired 166 million H-shares of Chinese steel producer Angang New Steel Co Ltd, which is due to make its trading debut in Hong Kong on Thursday.

China Everbright Holdings, a holding company controlled by China's State Council, said the "acquisition represents 7.5 percent of the enlarged share capital of Angang immediately after the offering and approximately 18.7 percent of the total H-shares to be listed".
It did not say how much it had paid for the stake.
Angang issued 890 million H-shares, or 40.3 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$1.63 per share in a global flotation.

The 89 million shares offered to the public in Hong Kong were only 99.7 percent subscribed. The 801 million shares placed internationally to professional and institutional investors were fully allotted.
H-shares are Hong Kong-listed shares in mainland Chinese enterprises.

Analysts have said shares in Angang -- the first H-share and the first new listing since Hong Kong reverted to Chinese rule on July 1 -- were expected to make a weak debut due to concern over the company's longer term profitability.
Angang produces steel products, including cold rolled sheets, wire rods and thick plates.
China Everbright Holdings has three Hong Kong-listed arms -- China Everbright International Ltd, China Everbright Technology Ltd and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd.
